# Third-Party Code

The `debugScreen` files are copies of `common/` of the vitasdk samples (github.com/vitasdk/samples). Do not change them.

- `debugScreen.c`, `debugScreen.h`, `debugScreen_custom.h`: vitasdk samples (CC0).
- `debugScreenFont.c`: the PSPSDK debug font (BSD license, see the file header).

`Makefile.vita` builds these files with `-w`, because they are not our code.
